title: BabyLM-10M language model experiment
goal: Run a BabyLM-10M end-to-end experiment. Train and evaluate word-level language models to minimize validation perplexity.
dataset: /data/BabyLM-2026-Strict-Small (6 .txt files, ~10M words, no separate validation set)
requirements: design 2-4 materially different word-level language model architectures
split train data into train/validation yourself
verify all .txt files are non-empty before use
train on real BabyLM-10M data with GPU acceleration
select best model by lowest word-level validation perplexity
